seats.name: foreman
seats.description: Plans, splits, judges and reports; never writes product code

seats.name: builder
seats.description: The only seat that writes product code; hands off evidence packets

seats.name: auditor
seats.description: Reproduces every evidence packet and attacks the changed surface; never edits product code

seats.name: gatekeeper
seats.description: Releases only what builds and starts offline from a fresh clone; never edits code

notes.harness: One harness for every seat. A Claude Code seat loads only the MCP servers the factory passes it (strict MCP config) and runs without web tools. A Codex seat inherits the operator's own Codex configuration (MCP servers, plugins, injected environment variables), which launch flags can add to but not remove.
notes.permission_mode: No seat can approve another seat's permission request, so every seat runs in a mode that needs none.
notes.claude_context: Claude subscription auth requires local_config context mode; CLAUDE.md at the repo root pins seats to the mandate.
notes.claude_model: Pinned so the Model line in each mandate is exact.
